messages:
morgan: pushing prod image for service-recs, cross-arch build finished but ECR push failed for arm64 with 409 conflict. staging succeeded.
deploy-bot: automated publish attempt recorded: `PUT /v2/service-recs/manifests` -> 409 Conflict, message: manifest with same tag exists but digest differs
jia: hmm does that mean arch manifests arrived out-of-order? I saw amd64 pushed first, then arm pushed but the final manifest list may have been created with older layer index
morgan: exact, arm push retried and timed out during KMS sign step, then the manifest list got created referencing only amd64 digest. now the tag points to amd64-only digest and our multiarch manifest got rejected.
ops-lead: rolling window is open for 30m. pause automated deploys? @release-coordinator
release-coordinator: yes please pause deploy-bot for service-recs. canary (staging->canary) held. tagging plan: retag the correct multiarch manifest to `prod-20240315-rc1` and update pinned digest in helm values, then resume.
matt: quick checklist: 1) confirm correct multiarch index exists in ECR with both digests; 2) cosign attestation present; 3) KMS keys not timing out; 4) update helm pinned digest and rerun canary
claudia: I can do 1+2 now. if cosign attestation is missing we should not re-tag; instead republish full manifest list from the build farm.
morgan: logs from the push (arm64):
```
[2024-03-15T14:02:12Z] push layer sha256:aaa... done
[2024-03-15T14:02:40Z] create manifest list -> 504 Gateway Timeout
[2024-03-15T14:03:10Z] retry create manifest -> 409 Conflict (existing manifest with tag)
[2024-03-15T14:03:20Z] cosign sign -> KMS ERROR: signing request timeout
```
jia: sounds like a race between manifest list create and cosign sign. if KMS delays, deploybot may see partial publish and mark as success.
ops-lead: decision: hold change window, pause deploy-bot for this repo, owners to coordinate manual retag or republish. no automatic rollback of canary since canary hasn't progressed.
release-coordinator: schedule: manual republish within 20m. if we can't republish with attestation within window, we'll rollback tag to the previous pinned digest and open a bug.
morgan: I'm going to try a manual republish from the build instance but will use `--sleep-between-arches 10s` to avoid ordering; will run cosign locally with local KMS creds to avoid remote timeout.
claudia: I'll validate attestation and manifest list after you finish, then update helm pin and create a small PR for release-ops to merge.
matt: reminder: update release notes with the reason and the exact digests we pinned. include mitigation: backoff + local cosign retry logic.
deploy-bot: note: automated resumes will not occur while channel flag `deploy-paused/service-recs` is set.
release-coordinator: thanks all. once PR is merged we unpause at +5 after canary verification. :thumbsup:
